scope: Reviewed account/profile section; not complete six-source conflict reconciliation or native policy.

rows.requirement: Keep each field optional except source-required display name, which need not be real-world identity. Profile product/version, field, audience, expiration and managed identity; require owner approval before disclosure and independently observe intended audiences. Private profile does not erase history or public-repository activity.
negative_tests: Missing optional bio/pronouns/hiring must not fail compliance.
Private profile cannot pass total historical/API erasure.
Default-public status without expiry cannot pass restricted time-bound disclosure.

rows.requirement: Use stable target identity and authenticated role/resource evidence for access; treat pins, top repositories, organization mentions and hidden membership as presentation only. Enforce combined six-pin maximum and eligibility separately from authorization.
negative_tests: Hidden membership cannot certify departure or loss of access.
Top-list/pinned repository cannot certify ownership.
Enterprise owner title cannot certify uniform organization resource access.

rows.requirement: Profile account provisioning, IdP, host and version before proposing signup, name/email changes, Gravatar or departure. Preserve specific managed-user exclusions over generic personal self-service prose; unresolved operation eligibility stays unknown. Display-name and username authority remain separate.
negative_tests: Personal Name field cannot authorize managed IdP mutation.
Generic historical email relinking cannot bypass managed primary-email limits.
Managed user cannot inherit personal self-removal or signup rights.

rows.requirement: Before approved departure establish retained mailbox/authentication/recovery, successor ownership, billing handoff, repository custody and exact organization/enterprise roles. Preview diffs, bound each mutation and verify afterward. Destructive local cleanup requires candidate-specific parity, worktree dependency and restore evidence; no upstream placeholder execution.
negative_tests: Leaving organization cannot pass billing handoff or enterprise removal.
Replacing 2FA without recovery verification cannot pass continuity.
A fork/upstream link or remote existence cannot authorize local deletion.

rows.requirement: Represent qualification as conjunctive commit criteria plus disjunctive relationship requirements; report graph/time-window caps and unknown display limits. Keep attribution, mailbox verification, authenticated authorship, repository custody and productivity separate. Profile/display absence is not proof of missing artifacts.
negative_tests: Linked author email alone cannot pass all commit criteria.
Historical graph restoration without mailbox access cannot pass mailbox custody.
One-month calendar selection or four-update dashboard cannot claim exhaustive activity.

rows.requirement: Preserve author/commit/event timezone distinctions and independently verify UTC query bounds, destination rendering, exact GHES version and two-account sign-in. Require owner Connect enablement, authentic user agreement and separate authorization for count sharing. Record 90-day scope and measured freshness rather than hourly request cadence.
negative_tests: A +0900 calendar day cannot automatically be substituted for UTC day bounds.
Hourly update requests cannot pass fresh successful sync.
Duplicated cloud sign-in wording cannot certify both environments authenticated.

rows.requirement: Classify personal display preferences, review-routing effects, bulk current-repository changes and future defaults separately. Security enable/disable requires exact owned target inventory, applicable explicit approval, diff, capability preconditions, behavioral verification and recovery plan; defaults do not prove current enforcement.
negative_tests: Future default cannot pass existing-repository coverage.
Enable all dialog cannot certify protection effectiveness.
Busy preference cannot be treated as blocking all manual review requests.

rows.requirement: Treat third-party registration/linkage, personal OAuth authorization, org requests/approval, AI sessions, dependency automation and public sharing as distinct scoped actions. Verify callback target/permissions and protect secrets; requests are not approval, session lists not live completion, generated text not truth and latest versions not tested safety. Preserve product/preview scope.
negative_tests: OAuth request or personal authorization cannot pass organization approval.
Dashboard session row cannot certify a running remote agent or achieved goal.
Copied AI README/latest dependency version cannot pass verified operational behavior.

limitations: Negative-test entries are specifications, not implemented or executed tests.
Source identity validation is not semantic equivalence or independent omission assurance.
No authentic human policy acceptance, rights clearance, identity/credential changes or rollout is supplied.
